faq_heading: Cloverdale coach houses: your questions answered

faq.q: Are RF-12C and RF-13 still zones in Cloverdale?
faq.a: No. Surrey replaced RF-12, RF-12C and RF-13 with the R4 Small Lot Residential zone on July 8, 2024. A listing that still uses the old names is out of date, so check the lot’s current zone.

faq.q: How big can a Cloverdale coach house be?
faq.a: Between 35 and 75 square metres. The limit is 120 on RA, R2, R2-O and R3 lots where the existing house is below its maximum floor area ratio.

faq.q: How much does a Cloverdale house with a coach house cost?
faq.a: About 2% above the all-house median. 24 Cloverdale houses marked as a coach or laneway house closed from November 1, 2025 to August 31, 2026 at a median of $1,324,750, against $1,300,000 for all Cloverdale detached houses. The flag is entered by the listing agent, so the true number is higher.

faq.q: What do Cloverdale houses sell for?
faq.a: The median was $1,297,500 over the year to October 22, 2026, from 306 sales. Clayton houses had a median of $1,295,000 and Cloverdale town houses $1,300,000.

faq.q: Can I add a coach house to a farm lot near Cloverdale?
faq.a: Not under Surrey’s small-scale rules. Those cover urban lots. A parcel in the Agricultural Land Reserve is governed by the Agricultural Land Commission, so check the Reserve first.

faq.q: How fast do Cloverdale houses sell?
faq.a: The median was 21 days, and homes closed at 96.8% of list price at a median. 7% sold over the list price.

faq.q: Which Cloverdale area has the smallest lots?
faq.a: Clayton, at a median lot of 3,270 sq ft against 7,088 sq ft in Cloverdale town.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Coach house figures come from the Carriage/Coach House and Laneway House style flags in Paragon closed sales, which the listing agent fills in, so the counts are small and will miss some. The live search is not connected yet.

These are detached houses for sale in Cloverdale and Clayton with a coach house on the lot. The two parts of this search look very different from each other: Cloverdale town has older and larger lots, and Clayton is the newer small-lot neighbourhood.

Paragon marks 24 of the 294 Cloverdale detached houses that closed from November 1, 2025 to August 31, 2026 as a coach house or laneway house. They sold at a median of $1,324,750, 2% above the $1,300,000 median for all Cloverdale houses in the same months. The flag is typed in by the listing agent, so treat the count as a floor and not a census. Over the year to October 22, 2026 all 306 Cloverdale and Clayton houses in the main sold file had a median of $1,297,500, about $1,317,200 on the Home Price Index benchmark, and 21 days was the median wait.
Clayton and Cloverdale are two different lots

Clayton’s houses that sold had a median lot of just 3,270 sq ft, built around 2006, and a median price of $1,295,000. In Cloverdale town the median lot was 7,088 sq ft, the median house was built in 1994 and the median price was $1,300,000. A Clayton lot is 46% the size of a typical lot in town, so a coach house there has to be planned in from the first day: the second home takes the place of a back yard.

blocks.text: Older Cloverdale listings can still talk about RF-12C or RF-13 coach-home zoning. Those names are gone. Surrey’s July 8, 2024 changes replaced RF-12, RF-12C and RF-13 with the R4 Small Lot Residential zone, and RF-SD became R6 Semi-Detached. Read the lot’s current zone in Zoning By-law No. 12000 before anyone quotes you coach house potential.

What a coach house can be today is set city-wide. It has to be between 35 and 75 square metres, up to 120 on RA, R2, R2-O and R3 lots below their maximum floor area ratio, with lane access for a coach house on smaller lots and one added parking space. A suite cannot sit inside a coach house or garden suite.

Cloverdale’s town centre has its own plan. The Cloverdale Town Centre Plan was approved on November 18, 2019 and an update was authorized in October 2023, so the plan map for the exact address is worth checking, and the City’s heritage inventory is the first check for an older house near the main street.

Cloverdale also has working farmland. Surrey’s small-scale housing rules are for urban lots; they are not a way to add a second home on a parcel in the Agricultural Land Reserve, where the Agricultural Land Commission sets what extra housing is allowed. Farm and acreage lots are covered in the buying rules for acreage on this site.

Two big projects are worth knowing about. The new Surrey Hospital and BC Cancer Centre at 5500 180 Street started construction in September 2023, with completion expected in 2030, and the Surrey-Langley SkyTrain, 16 kilometres long with a station at Clayton, is under construction and expected in late 2029.
